response.sql:
WITH scan_rates AS (
  SELECT s.questregistry,
         si.healtheval,
         s.scancount,
         s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0) AS rate
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
), status_stats AS (
  SELECT healtheval,
         AVG(rate) AS avg_rate,
         AVG(scancount) AS avg_count
  FROM scan_rates
  GROUP BY healtheval
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS all_status_avg_rate
  FROM status_stats
), qualifying AS (
  SELECT ss.avg_rate, ss.avg_count, o.all_status_avg_rate
  FROM status_stats AS ss
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE o.all_status_avg_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.avg_rate > o.all_status_avg_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS average_rate,
       AVG(avg_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(avg_rate - all_status_avg_rate) AS average_excess
FROM qualifying;

assumptions.assumption: “Average count” means the average of scans.scancount within each qualifying health and safety status, then the unweighted average of those status averages. The all-status average likewise gives each status equal weight. Zero-minute scans are excluded from rate averages; missing rates are ignored.

alternatives.interpretation: If “average count” means the average number of matched scan records per qualifying status, use this query instead.

  SELECT s.questregistry,
         si.healtheval,
         s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0) AS rate

), status_stats AS (
  SELECT healtheval,
         AVG(rate) AS avg_rate,
         COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scan_rates
  GROUP BY healtheval

  FROM status_stats AS ss
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE o.all_status_avg_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND ss.avg_rate > o.all_status_avg_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS average_rate,
       AVG(scan_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(avg_rate - all_status_avg_rate) AS average_excess
FROM qualifying;
